content:
alex: Heads-up — we're bringing up a 3-node GPU cluster in eu-west-3 tomorrow 09:00 CET. Drafting the security baseline + quick handoff checklist here, please skim and call out gaps. Need someone to own runbook + IAM/KMS review.

alex: Checklist (draft):
- [ ] IAM roles: least-privilege roles for node, kubelet, model-run, infra-agent
- [ ] KMS/HSM: customer CMK support + admin/usage separation, key rotation enabled
- [ ] Secrets: Secrets Manager with resource policies + rotation; no plaintext in S3
- [ ] Network: deny-all egress by default, VPC endpoints for registries, egress allowlist
- [ ] Audit/logging: CloudTrail, Config, aggregated to central audit account, S3 bucket KMS-encrypted
- [ ] Policy-as-code: OPA/Conftest checks in pipeline for IAM & bucket policies
- [ ] On-prem HSM test path (if private deployment): CI+operational runbook
- [ ] Terraform plan reviewed + automated CI checks

devon: LGTM. Couple of clarifications: what principal do we give on the KMS key policy for the model-serving nodes? cross-account for Dedicated customers?

maya: For Dedicated we support customer-managed keys in their account (we only get an encrypt/decrypt/grant role via cross-account IAM role). For hosted clusters we'll use Redwood-managed key but with a strict key policy denying actions outside the infra role. Example KW snippet (terraform KMS key) to be used as a pattern:

```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "cluster_key" {
  description             = "eu-west-3 cluster CMK - limited to infra-role"
  enable_key_rotation     = true
  policy                  = data.aws_iam_policy_document.kms_policy.json
}
```

priya: Secrets: ensure rotation lambda runs in same account and has kms:Decrypt for the CMK. No secrets ever stored in plain S3. Add resource-level constraints on rotate permission. Also add a Secrets Manager resource policy that denies GetSecretValue unless req.sourceVpc or req.sourceIp in allowlist.

devon: Network/egress note: we'll block wide egress from worker subnet and only allow endpoints: model-registry.redwood.internal, pypi/cdn ranges, metrics ingest. I'll publish the allowlist IP ranges in the infra repo; add to egress policy.

alex: Added items. Who can own the runbook and the handoff doc? Need someone to add the terraform test and the Conftest policies.

priya: I can own the runbook + terraform modules. I'll add automated tests in CI and a Conftest bundle for the IAM/KMS patterns.

maya: I'll take IAM role review + least-privilege policies. I'll add a small policy template for node vs. model-run roles (no wildcards).

devon: I'll validate KMS policies and run HSM connectivity checks for private clusters. I'll add a small script to verify HSM PKCS11 endpoint during bootstrap.

alex: Great. Quick reminders for the handoff doc: include these items explicitly:
- owner + oncall contact
- acceptance criteria (no public buckets, no wildcard principals, audit logging enabled)
- verification steps (list of CLI checks we run post-apply)

alex: example verification snippet to include in runbook (run after terraform apply):
```bash
# check CloudTrail enabled and multi-region
aws cloudtrail get-trail-status --name prod-audit-trail
# check bucket encryption
aws s3api get-bucket-encryption --bucket redwood-audit-bucket
# check kms key rotation enabled
aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/cluster-euw3-key
```

maya: Also add a quick IAM trust example for the infra service account so reviewers can spot issues fast:

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/infra-agent"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abc1234"}}
    }
  ]
}
```

priya: Don't forget CloudTrail -> S3 bucket policy must block delete unless request comes from central-audit account. We'll include a deny statement for s3:DeleteBucket unless aws:PrincipalAccount == central-audit-account.

devon: For HSM customers: test vector for PKCS11 derived signature exchange during bootstrap. I'll attach the script in the repo, but runbooks must document fallback (use local KMS shim) if HSM unavailable.

sre-bot: Ticket created SEC-4021 for eu-west-3 security onboarding. Assignees: priya, maya, devon. Status: open.

alex: OK, thanks everyone. I'll schedule a 30m handoff tomorrow 10:00 CET and link the ticket in the calendar invite. Please add any final blockers before EOD.

maya: +1 :thumbsup:

priya: adding tests now, ping if you need me to pair on the rollout.

devon: I'll post allowlist ranges in infra repo PR by EOD.
